notes: Restore the pinned Submodule.IsLattice predicate to Submodule.IsFullLattice throughout the valuation-ring lattice structures, hypotheses and instances. In this setting k is the fraction field of O[k], so target IsFullLattice is equivalent to the original FG and full k-span=top condition: the new parent IsLattice is supplied by IsLattice.of_fg. All lattice carriers, quotient/reduction maps, residue functionals, uniformizer choices/scalings, pair/gluing equivalences, scalar/GL actions and standard-coordinate constructions retain their original formulas. Necessary finite/free facts and constructor proof fields are derived from the same hypotheses; no theorem hypothesis, import, resource limit or data map is strengthened or replaced. The new independence field follows from the existing IsFractionRing structure of the valuation subring, for arbitrary n. Pair, IsGlue and GluePair retain the same non-proof fields and conditions; replacing the lattice proof field gives mutually inverse transports by proof irrelevance. The target basis extension still sends each basis vector to its ambient inclusion; the original ambient GL construction and inverse pullback of functionals are retained.
